doc.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Bill Harris as partner
summary: Phillips praises Bill Harris as a versatile, soulful player.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Now you and Bill Harris were quite a team.

Oh — he was my partner. He was great. Play any which way you want you know. Play as soulful as a — or lagging, or fighting, shout, a lovely ballad, he’d play it any way, any mood you’d get in, he was there. He was a good player.
